name: wds_flickr30k
description: A webdataset-formatted version of the Flickr30k image-caption dataset intended for image–text benchmark tasks. It is used mainly for image-caption retrieval and image-to-text / text-to-image matching and for evaluating multimodal encoders (e.g., CLIP-style models). The dataset contains images with multiple human-written captions and is popular for retrieval and captioning research.
evaluation_method: Recall@k (e.g., R@1, R@5, R@10) for retrieval; BLEU/METEOR/CIDEr sometimes used for captioning
general_score_metric: Recall@k (R@1 / R@5 / R@10) for retrieval tasks
typical_sota_score: R@1 typically in the ~60–90% range depending on model size and evaluation protocol
reputation: Flickr30k is a well-known, widely used dataset for image captioning and retrieval research, though smaller and older than some recent multi-modal corpora.
